title: AI/ML Developer
company: Horizon17 Technology and Sustainability Pvt Ltd
description:
Horizon17 is hiring an AI/ML developer with 2–3 years of experience to build production AI modules for a document-intelligence and report-generation product.

About Horizon17

Horizon17 is a technology company. Our engineering teams build solutions across AI and machine learning, generative AI, blockchain, mobile, web, cloud and data.

We work in two ways. We build for clients, from strategy and design through engineering, launch and support. We also build and run our own in-house products, so we treat every system as owners would.

This role sits on one of those products. It reads unstructured documents and generates accurate, source-backed reports from them, with a human approving before anything is final.

What you will do

* **Report generation:**
  design and build LLM-powered generation of long-form, structured reports: sections, tables, citations and multi-format output.
* **RAG pipelines:**
  own document parsing, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking and source citation, so every claim can show where it came from.
* **Agent workflows:**
  build planning, generation, regeneration and review flows in LangGraph and LangChain.
* **Document intelligence:**
  turn PDFs, scans, spreadsheets and other unstructured files into usable text and structure.
* **Classification and scoring:**
  build NLP and ML modules that classify, extract and score data points, with explainable outputs.
* **Human in the loop:**
  add conversational edits, clarification, approval, versioning and audit history, so missing or conflicting data triggers a question instead of an invented number.
* **Production APIs:**
  write Python services other product teams consume, including async jobs and streaming responses.
* **Evaluation and quality gates:**
  measure faithfulness and retrieval quality, run regression tests in CI, and monitor for hallucination and drift.
* **Module ownership:**
  take modules from design through production, write design docs, and take part in code reviews.
* **Domain translation:**
  work with product and domain experts to turn reporting rules into configuration and tests, so new document types do not need a rewrite.

What you bring

* 2-3 years of professional engineering experience in Python (3.10+), with at least 1.5 years building LLM features that run in production.
* Production LLM work with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic or similar: prompting, structured output, retries, rate limits, and cost and latency trade-offs.
* Cost and token optimisation: has measured and cut LLM spend in production through prompt and context trimming, prompt caching, model routing (small model first, large model only when needed), batching, and per-feature token budgets with cost tracking.
* Hands-on RAG experience: embeddings, vector search, chunking strategy, reranking and retrieval evaluation.
* LangChain and LangGraph, or another agent orchestration framework, used for multi-step stateful workflows.
* Production backend skills: FastAPI or Flask, REST APIs, async Python, background jobs, and streaming over WebSockets or token streaming.
* Document AI and OCR: Azure Document Intelligence, Docling, PyMuPDF or similar.
* Measured LLM and RAG quality with RAGAS, DeepEval or equivalent, and pytest regression suites that gate releases.
* Strong data-layer skills: Pydantic, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis.
* Has built and shipped at least one AI module end to end, from design to production.
* Fine-tuning or serving open-source models.
* Clear written communication: prompts, evaluation notes and technical design docs.

Good to have

* ESG, sustainability or carbon accounting: GHG Protocol, Scope 1/2/3, BRSR, CDP, GRI or CSRD.
* High-stakes document products in finance, legal, healthcare or compliance reporting.
* Knowledge graphs (Neo4j or similar), or hybrid RAG and graph retrieval.
* Approval, audit and versioning workflows in an AI product.
* Docker, CI/CD and cloud deployment and monitoring of AI services.
* Classical ML where it fits: scikit-learn, XGBoost, sentence-transformers and explainability with SHAP.

title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
**About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.**

**Why Explore a Career at Navi?**

**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact**

At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.

**Where Careers Accelerate**

Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.

**Where Great Talent Builds Together**

We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.

**About the Team**

The Data Science team at Navi plays a central role in building intelligent solutions that power our products and drive business impact. We work across key domains such as Lending, Collections, KYC, UPI Growth and Ads recommendation, applying advanced machine learning/deep learning/GenAI techniques to solve high-impact challenges. Our work involves a diverse range of data types—including text, image, and tabular data—and we closely collaborate with cross-functional teams like Product, Business, Engineering, etc. to deliver end-to-end solutions.

**About the Role**

This role offers the opportunity to lead high-impact data science initiatives that directly shape Navi’s strategic business decisions. As a Lead Data Scientist, you will operate at the intersection of advanced machine learning, large-scale data processing, and cross-functional collaboration—building scalable, production-ready solutions that drive significant business value. You will work across multiple business units, tackling Navi’s most complex and high-priority challenges, while fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous innovation, and mentorship within the team. Your contributions will be instrumental in unlocking new opportunities, accelerating growth, and establishing data science as a core strategic asset at Navi.

**What You’ll Own**

* **Lead High-Impact Projects:**
  Oversee and manage end-to-end high priority data science projects across domains by breaking down complex problems, planning timelines, allocating resources, and ensuring timely, high-quality delivery of results.
* **Mentorship & Team Development:**
  Mentor and coach a team of data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning, professional growth, and technical excellence. Guide team members in their project work and support their career advancement.
* **POC & SOTA Solution Delivery:**
  Rapidly solve complex problems by designing and executing quick POCs using state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches, and deliver best-in-class ML solutions that create clear differentiation and business impact.
* **Strategic Vision & Innovation:**
  Define the strategic roadmap for the team, set technical direction, and champion the development of data-driven solutions for complex business challenges. Ensure alignment with organizational objectives and foster a culture of innovation.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership:**
  Build and nurture strong relationships with stakeholders across business, product, and engineering. Identify opportunities, shape strategic initiatives, and drive the successful integration of data science solutions into core business functions.
* **Model Quality & Monitoring Excellence:**
  Establish robust metrics and quality standards for evaluating model performance and business impact. Implement and oversee industry-leading systems for model monitoring to ensure reliability, scalability, and long-term value.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a quantitative field, with a strong research orientation and at least
  **7 years**
  of relevant experience in data science
* **Deep expertise**
  in modern machine learning techniques, mathematical foundations, and hands-on experience with leading ML frameworks (such as scikit-learn, Keras, TensorFlow, PySpark, MLlib, etc.)
* Extensive experience with
  **distributed computing platforms**
  and scalable data processing (e.g. Spark)
* Advanced programming skills, preferably in Python, Scala, or similar languages, with a track record of delivering robust, production-grade solutions
* Proven ability to lead and deliver large-scale machine learning projects
  **end-to-end**
  —from problem definition, data exploration, and modeling, to deployment and production monitoring
* Demonstrated experience in
  **mentoring**
  junior data scientists, including setting technical direction and driving best practices
* Strong business acumen and the ability to
  **translate complex data-driven insights into actionable strategies**
  that create significant business impact
* Skilled in designing, executing, and scaling
  **A/B**
  or multivariate experiments to validate and optimize data science solutions
* Excellent communication and
  **stakeholder management**
  skills, with experience collaborating across business, product, and engineering functions
* Proven track record of driving innovation and staying current with the
  **latest advancements**
  in machine learning and data science

**The Navi OS**

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.

* **Start with the Customer**
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade - Not a Day
* Win as One

We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.

To read more about the Navi OS, visit
navi.com/our-values

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

navi.com/careers/life-at-navi

title: Lean 4 Proof Engineer - Mathematical Formalization
description:
**Lean 4 Proof Engineer — Mathematical Formalization (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
What if your deep mathematical expertise could directly shape how AI understands and reasons about formal proof? We're looking for Lean 4 Proof Engineers to translate advanced mathematical arguments into machine-verifiable formalizations — working at the absolute frontier of what proof assistants can express, capture, and automate.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role for mathematicians who thrive on precision, structural elegance, and the challenge of making rigorous human reasoning legible to a machine.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Translate informal mathematical proofs into Lean 4 (and related proof systems) with an emphasis on clarity, correctness, and structure
* Analyze proofs across domains — algebra, analysis, topology, logic, discrete math — identifying gaps, hidden assumptions, and formalizable substructures
* Construct formalizations that test and extend the limits of existing proof assistants, especially where automation breaks down
* Investigate why automated provers fail — complexity barriers, missing lemmas, insufficient libraries — and articulate those failure modes clearly
* Develop highly readable, reproducible proof scripts aligned with mathematical best practices and Lean idioms
* Collaborate with AI researchers to design and refine strategies for improving formal verification pipelines
* Create Lean proofs that reveal deeper patterns or generalizations implicit in the original mathematics
* Provide expert guidance on proof decomposition, lemma selection, and structuring techniques for formal models

**Who You Are**

* Hold a Master's degree or higher in Mathematics, Logic, Theoretical Computer Science, or a closely related field
* Have a strong foundation in rigorous proof writing and mathematical reasoning across one or more of: algebra, analysis, topology, logic, or discrete mathematics
* Have hands-on experience with Lean (Lean 3 or Lean 4), Coq, Isabelle/HOL, Agda, or a comparable formal proof system — Lean 4 strongly preferred
* Genuinely excited about formal verification, proof assistants, and the future of mechanized mathematics
* Able to translate dense, informal mathematical arguments into clean, structured, machine-checkable proofs
* Self-directed and comfortable working independently in an asynchronous remote environment

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with type theory, the Curry-Howard correspondence, and proof automation tools
* Experience contributing to large-scale formalization projects such as Mathlib
* Exposure to theorem provers where automated reasoning frequently fails or requires extensive manual scaffolding
* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems
* Strong communication skills for documenting formalization decisions, edge cases, and reasoning strategies

**The Ideal Candidate**
You're a mathematically mature problem-solver who finds genuine satisfaction in taking a dense, elegant human argument and expressing it in a form a machine can verify. You appreciate precision, structural beauty, and the intellectual challenge of resolving gaps that automated tools cannot yet bridge. You're energized by working at the frontier — not frustrated by it.
  
  
**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside world-leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, intellectually rigorous work
* Direct exposure to how advanced AI models are trained and evaluated
* Contribute to work that maps the outer limits of what formal verification can achieve
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch
